text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning to run the user_profiles schema migration + backfill tomorrow (Sun) 02:00 UTC. Proposed dual-write window 02:00-03:30. Need a deploy owner, smoke lead, and rollback readiness. @Ajay @Sam @Lina — can you take roles?

Ajay: I can own the deploy. High-level plan:
- 01:30 staging canary
- 01:50 preflight checks (replica lag, migrations dry-run)
- 02:00 start cutover, enable dual-write
- 02:10 start backfill job
- Monitor until 04:00, then evaluate safe window to remove dual-write
Please confirm migration id + backfill job name and I'll add commands to the runbook.

Maria: migration id: 2026-03-user-profiles-v2; backfill job: job:user_profiles.backfill_v2. Feature flag: user_profiles_v2. Runbook link: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/user-profiles-migration (will update with final commands).

Lina: Quick downstream callouts: search-indexer and notifications consume the user payload. Indexer tolerates extra fields but notifications assume email present — we'll need to ensure no nulls. I'll validate consumers are forward-compatible by 01:30.

Sam: I'll run smoke tests and sit on pager 01:45-04:30. Smoke checklist (short):
1) POST create user (v2 schema) and assert 201
2) GET user by id through public API
3) Check indexer processed the event
Commands I'll use:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/users -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"smoke","schema_version":2}'
curl -X GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/users/smoke
kubectl logs -l app=indexer -c indexer | tail -n 50
```
I'll post pass/fail in this thread.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: #INC-5421. Calendar event scheduled for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC — invite sent to Ajay, Sam, Lina, Maria, and oncall.

Ajay: Rollback plan (short):
- Toggle feature flag user_profiles_v2 -> off (switch reads to v1)
- Disable dual-write (dualwrite=false in config)
- Cancel backfill: `kc run job cancel-backfill --env=prod --job=job:user_profiles.backfill_v2`
- If rollback required, freeze writes (brief maintenance), run DB rollback scripts from runbook, and monitor queue/backpressure. I'll paste the exact commands in the runbook page.

Maria: Updated runbook with canary steps and rollback commands; assigning roles: Ajay = deploy owner, Sam = smoke lead, Lina = downstream lead. I'm pinging @Jane (oncall) for standby.

Jane (oncall): I'll be on standby 01:50-04:00. If replica lag > 30s or write error spikes >1000/min, page me immediately. :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks all. If no blockers I will mark GO in ~12 hours and post final preflight checklist. :rocket:
